messages:
Alex C: Hey team, first day — I think I have VPN + bastion access but I can't reach the internal dashboard at 10.4.3.12:8080. I can ssh to the bastion but curl from WSL2 times out. Using Win11 corp image (BitLocker) + WSL2. Any quick checks?

Maya (eng-infra): Welcome Alex! Quick Qs: did the VPN client report routes pushed for 10.4.0.0/16? Also did you finish Okta MFA + device cert enrollment? Can you paste `wsl ip route` and `ipconfig /all` output (snip is fine).

Alex C: Ok pasted minimal output below — looks like WSL2 has only a default route, no 10.4 route:
```
$ wsl ip route
default via 172.23.112.1 dev eth0
172.23.112.0/20 dev eth0 proto kernel scope link src 172.23.116.5
```
Windows ipconfig shows a "VPN - Company" adapter with route 10.4.0.0/16 present.

Samir (eng-infra): If Windows has the route but WSL2 doesn't, that's a WSL networking namespace issue — WSL2 doesn't inherit Windows routes by default. Also confirm the corp VPN is in split-tunnel mode; that affects pushed routes.

Onboard Bot: vpn-manager: VPN profile applied for user Alex C. Routes pushed: 10.4.0.0/16 -> vpn0.

Alex C: I did enroll in Okta + got the device cert yesterday. So cert is present. Any recommended commands to sync routes into WSL?

Maya (eng-infra): Two quick fixes: 1) `wsl --shutdown` then restart WSL (can pull Windows routes back during startup). 2) If that doesn't work, we have a small helper script on the infra tools bucket: `wsl-route-sync` (internal) that copies Windows VPN routes into WSL on resume. For a one-off you can run inside WSL: `sudo ip route add 10.4.0.0/16 via 172.23.112.1` (replace with your WSL gateway).

Alex C: Running `wsl --shutdown` then reopened Ubuntu in WSL and re-ran `wsl ip route` — now I see 10.4.0.0/16 via 172.23.112.1. Curl to 10.4.3.12:8080 now returns HTML. Nice! :tada:

Maya (eng-infra): Nice. I'll add a short note to the new-hires checklist about Win11+WSL route sync and link to the helper script. @onboard-team fyi.

Alex C: Thanks everyone — saved my first-day debugging time. Where's the docs link for the helper?

Samir (eng-infra): https://internal.docs/redwood/infra/wsl-route-sync — will add more examples (windows gateway lookup, persistent service).

Maya (eng-infra): If anyone else hits this, ping `#eng-infra` or @maya. Quick checklist we added: Okta MFA, device cert, VPN connected, `wsl --shutdown` if WSL network missing routes.

Alex C: Logged. Appreciate the help! :raised_hands:
